proposal.reason: Repair: the module runs under 'use strict', so the returned memoized function is strict, not sloppy; that preserves primitive receivers such as 0 when forwarding to resultFn. The default comparator is also strict and matches the installed code: same array length, then per-element equality by === except NaN matches NaN; signed zeros still compare equal. Cache is reused only after a prior successful result, same receiver by ===, and truthy comparator result. Comparator and result callback throws propagate without updating cached state.
